## Draugr Captain (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
Draugr captain rogue 2  
CE Medium undead (water)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +12  


**Defense**


**AC** 21, touch 15, flat-footed 16 (+1 dodge, +2 armor, +4 Dex, +4 natural)  
**hp** 72 (6d8+24)  
**Fort** +5 **Ref** +8 **Will** +7  
**Defensive Abilities** evasion; DR 5/bludgeoning or slashing; Immune undead traits; Resist fire 10  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., swim 30 ft.  
**Melee** mwk scimitar +13 (1d6+10/18–20 plus energy drain) or slam +11 (1d10+10 plus energy drain)  
**Special Attacks** energy drain (1 level, DC 16), sneak attack +2d6  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 6th; concentration +9)  


3/day—obscuring mist  



**Statistics**


**Str** 25, **Dex** 18, Con—, **Int** 14, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 17  
**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +11; **CMD** 26  
**Feats** Combat Reflexes, Weapon Focus (scimitar), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +13, Bluff +10, Climb +16, Intimidate +12, Perception +12, Profession (sailor) +12, Stealth +13, Swim +24  
**Languages** Common (cannot speak)  
**SQ** rogue talents (bleeding attack +2), trapfinding +1  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any oceans or coastlines  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** NPC gear (leather armor, masterwork scimitar, other treasure)
